__inputs.name: DS_LOKI
__inputs.label: Loki
__inputs.description: Loki datasource receiving the sclone logs

title: Sclone — S3/Swift synchronisation
description: Health, errors, performance and buckets of the sclone synchronisations, from the logfmt logs shipped to Loki. Hover the ⓘ of each panel: what it measures, the normal value and what to do.

links.title: Documentation (grafana.md)
links.tooltip: sclone events, fields, queries and alerts

list.name: selector
list.label: Loki stream selector
list.description: Stream selector of the sclone logs, e.g. {unit=~"sclone.*"} or {host="my-server"}

list.name: job
list.label: Job (regex)
list.description: Regex on the logfmt field job (configuration "name" / SCLONE_NAME)

list.name: event
list.label: Event (regex, logs)
list.description: Regex on the event field, applied to the Error and warning logs panel, e.g. deletion_refused or transfer_failed|sync_skipped

list.name: Failed runs
list.expr: ${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | status="failed"

list.name: Refused deletions
list.expr: ${selector} |= "event=deletion_refused" | logfmt | event="deletion_refused" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}"

panels.title: Last run status
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the result of the last run of each job in the time range (`sync_end`, `dry_run` excluded).

**Normal value**: **Success** (green) for every job.

**When to worry / what to do**: a **Failed** (red) job: read the `error` field, open *Error and warning logs* filtered on `event=sync_end` (*Event* variable). A missing job ran nothing in the range: check its service (cron, systemd unit).

targets.expr: last_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | status!="dry_run" | label_format ok=`{{ if eq .status "success" }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | unwrap ok | __error__="" [$__range]) by (sclone_job)

panels.title: Time since last success
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the time elapsed between the end of the time range and the last successful run of each job (`sync_end status=success`).

**Normal value**: about the cron interval. The thresholds (orange 15 min, red 1 h) fit a cron every few minutes: **adjust them** to your schedule.

**When to worry / what to do**: red: the job has not synchronised for too long, even if some runs ran. Check *Last run status*, then *Top errors*. *No success* means no successful run in the whole range.

targets.expr: ${__to:date:seconds} - max by (sclone_job) (max_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | status="success" | label_format success_at=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap success_at | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Success rate
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the share of successful runs in the time range, per job (`sync_end status=success` / all runs except `dry_run`).

**Normal value**: 100 %. Green ≥ 99 %, orange ≥ 95 %, red below.

**When to worry / what to do**: compare with *Success rate per job* to date the drop, then read *Top errors* and *Failures by HTTP status*.

targets.expr: (sum by (sclone_job) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | status="success" [$__range])) / sum by (sclone_job) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | status!="dry_run" [$__range]))) or on(sclone_job) (0 * sum by (sclone_job) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | status!="dry_run" [$__range])))

panels.title: Runs
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the number of runs in the time range by result (`sync_end status`), and the skipped cron ticks (`sync_skipped`).

**Normal value**: only successes; 0 failed, 0 interrupted, 0 skipped.

**When to worry / what to do**: **Failed**: see *Last run status* and *Top errors*. **Interrupted**: the process was stopped during a run (`SIGTERM` of `systemctl stop`/`restart`, `SIGINT`), field `signal`; expected during a deployment, otherwise check who stops the service. **Skipped**: see *Skipped runs by reason* (run longer than the cron interval, lock held by another process).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | status="success" [$__range])) or vector(0)

sum(count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | status="failed" [$__range])) or vector(0)

sum(count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | status="interrupted" [$__range])) or vector(0)

sum(count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | status="dry_run" [$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_skipped" | logfmt | event="sync_skipped" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Refused deletions
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the deletion refusals in the time range (`deletion_refused`): `maxDeletion` exceeded, empty side, or Swift container with `X-Versions-Location`. Uploads still run, the run fails.

**Normal value**: 0.

**When to worry / what to do**: any value > 0 is red: the refused deletions were not done. See *Refused deletions by reason*, then open *Error and warning logs* filtered on `event=deletion_refused` (*Event* variable). Check the storage before raising `maxDeletion` or enabling `allowEmptySide`.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=deletion_refused" | logfmt | event="deletion_refused" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Success rate per job
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the success rate per 15 min slot and per job (`dry_run` excluded).

**Normal value**: a flat line at 100 %. The dashed lines mark 99 % and 95 %.

**When to worry / what to do**: a lasting drop below 95 %: read *Failures by HTTP status* and *Top errors* over the same period.

targets.expr: (sum by (sclone_job) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | status="success" [$__interval])) / sum by (sclone_job) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | status!="dry_run" [$__interval]))) or on(sclone_job) (0 * sum by (sclone_job) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | status!="dry_run" [$__interval])))

panels.title: Skipped runs by reason
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the cron ticks not run (`sync_skipped`) by reason: previous run still running (`already_running`), lock held by another process (`locked`), lock file cannot be created (`lock_error`).

**Normal value**: 0. A few isolated `already_running` are acceptable after an unusually long run.

**When to worry / what to do**: repeated `already_running`: runs last longer than the cron interval, space the cron or see *Run duration*. `locked`: another sclone synchronises the same storages, see *Blocking lock age*. `lock_error`: the lock directory is missing or read-only.

targets.expr: sum by (sclone_job) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_skipped" | logfmt | event="sync_skipped" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | reason="already_running" [$__interval]))

sum by (sclone_job) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_skipped" | logfmt | event="sync_skipped" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | reason="locked" [$__interval]))

sum by (sclone_job) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_skipped" | logfmt | event="sync_skipped" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | reason="lock_error" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Refused deletions by reason
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the deletion refusals (`deletion_refused`) by reason: `max_deletion` (more deletions than `maxDeletion`), `empty_side` (a side listed empty), `swift_versions_stack` (Swift container with `X-Versions-Location`).

**Normal value**: no bar.

**When to worry / what to do**: `max_deletion`: confirm a mass deletion is intended before raising `maxDeletion`. `empty_side`: check the empty bucket (wrong bucket, permissions). `swift_versions_stack`: switch the container to `X-History-Location` or disable `delete`. Details: open *Error and warning logs* filtered on `event=deletion_refused` (*Event* variable).

targets.expr: sum by (sclone_job) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=deletion_refused" | logfmt | event="deletion_refused" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | reason="max_deletion" [$__interval]))

sum by (sclone_job) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=deletion_refused" | logfmt | event="deletion_refused" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | reason="empty_side" [$__interval]))

sum by (sclone_job) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=deletion_refused" | logfmt | event="deletion_refused" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | reason="swift_versions_stack" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Postponed deletions
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the files missing from a listing but not deleted from the other side (`deletion_skipped`, field `count`): still present on `HEAD` (`still_present`), or not confirmed (`not_confirmed`, counted as failed).

**Normal value**: 0. A few `still_present` can appear when files are created during the listing.

**When to worry / what to do**: `not_confirmed` > 0 fails the run: the `HEAD` failed after the retries, see *Failures by HTTP status*. Many `still_present`: incomplete listing on the storage side, open *Error and warning logs* filtered on `event=deletion_skipped` (*Event* variable).

targets.expr: sum by (sclone_job) (sum_over_time(${selector} |= "event=deletion_skipped" | logfmt | event="deletion_skipped" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | reason="still_present" | unwrap count | __error__="" [$__interval]))

sum by (sclone_job) (sum_over_time(${selector} |= "event=deletion_skipped" | logfmt | event="deletion_skipped" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | reason="not_confirmed" | unwrap count | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Blocking lock age
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the age of the process holding the lock when a tick is skipped (`sync_skipped reason=locked`, field `held_ms`).

**Normal value**: no data: no other process holds the lock.

**When to worry / what to do**: above 10 min (red line, the stale-lock delay) the tick is logged as `error`: the other process is stuck or very slow. Find its `pid`: open *Error and warning logs* filtered on `event=sync_skipped` (*Event* variable). An abandoned lock is taken over automatically (`lock_stale`).

targets.expr: max by (sclone_job) (max_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_skipped" | logfmt | event="sync_skipped" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | reason="locked" | unwrap held_ms | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Failed files
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the files that failed in the time range (sum of the `failed` field of `sync_end`): uploads, deletions and unconfirmed `HEAD` checks.

**Normal value**: 0.

**When to worry / what to do**: orange from 1, red from 100: read *Failures by HTTP status* (403 = permissions, 5xx = storage, no status = network) and *Top errors*.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | unwrap failed | __error__="" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Files too large
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the uploads refused because the file exceeds 5 GiB, the limit of a single upload (`transfer_failed reason=too_large`). Capped at `logMaxFailures` lines per queue and run.

**Normal value**: 0.

**When to worry / what to do**: any value > 0: these files will never be copied. List them in *Top errors* or open *Error and warning logs* filtered on `event=transfer_failed` (*Event* variable) (field `key`).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=transfer_failed" | logfmt | event="transfer_failed" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | reason="too_large" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Lock errors
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the ticks skipped because the lock file cannot be created (`sync_skipped reason=lock_error`).

**Normal value**: 0.

**When to worry / what to do**: any value > 0 is red: no synchronisation happens. Check that the lock directory exists and is writable; exact message: open *Error and warning logs* filtered on `event=sync_skipped` (*Event* variable).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_skipped" | logfmt | event="sync_skipped" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | reason="lock_error" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Cache errors and stale locks
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the unusable caches (`cache_error`: unreadable, corrupted, written for other storages) and the abandoned locks taken over (`lock_stale`).

**Normal value**: 0.

**When to worry / what to do**: a `cache_error` makes the next run a first synchronisation (nothing is deleted because of it); if it repeats, check the disk and the cache path. A `lock_stale` means a sclone process stopped abruptly. Details: *Error and warning logs* filtered on `event=cache_error|lock_stale`.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=cache_error" | logfmt | event="cache_error" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" [$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=lock_stale" | logfmt | event="lock_stale" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failures by HTTP status
panels.description:
**What it measures**: one bar per failed attempt (`transfer_failed`) by job, operation (`op`) and HTTP status (`status`). Capped at `logMaxFailures` lines per queue and run.

**Normal value**: no bar.

**When to worry / what to do**: 403: permissions or archived object; 404: object deleted after the listing; 5xx: storage unavailable; no status: network error (field `code`, e.g. `ECONNRESET`). See *Top errors* for the messages.

targets.expr: sum by (sclone_job, op, status) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=transfer_failed" | logfmt | event="transfer_failed" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Connection and listing failures
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the storage connections that failed (`storage_connect_failed`) and the listing pages requested again (`listing_retry`).

**Normal value**: no bar.

**When to worry / what to do**: a failed connection blocks the whole run: check credentials, endpoint and network. Repeated listing retries announce a slow or unstable storage: see *Listing duration p95*. Details: *Error and warning logs* filtered on `event=storage_connect_failed|listing_retry`.

targets.expr: sum by (sclone_job, side) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=storage_connect_failed" | logfmt | event="storage_connect_failed" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" [$__interval]))

sum by (sclone_job, side, bucket) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=listing_retry" | logfmt | event="listing_retry" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Top errors
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the 20 most frequent transfer errors in the time range (`transfer_failed`), by job, operation, phase, HTTP status and message.

**Normal value**: empty table.

**When to worry / what to do**: fix the most frequent line first; the *Error* column gives the cause. For the keys involved, open *Error and warning logs* filtered on `event=transfer_failed` (*Event* variable).

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (sclone_job, op, phase, status, error) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=transfer_failed" | logfmt | event="transfer_failed" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top jobs by failed runs
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the 10 jobs with the most failed runs in the time range (`sync_end status=failed`).

**Normal value**: empty.

**When to worry / what to do**: start with the first job: *Last run status* tells if it is still failing, *Top errors* filtered with the *Job* variable gives the cause.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (sclone_job) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | status="failed" [$__range])))

panels.title: Bidirectional conflicts
panels.description:
**What it measures**: in bidirectional mode, the files changed on both sides (`sync_conflict`) by reason: `both_new`, `both_modified`, `deleted_modified`. At most 100 lines per run.

**Normal value**: 0, or a few when both sides are edited at the same time. Always empty in unidirectional mode.

**When to worry / what to do**: sclone keeps one version (field `winner`), the other one is overwritten: check the important files, open the logs filtered on `event=sync_conflict` (fields `key`, `winner`). Many conflicts after a first run without cache are expected.

targets.expr: sum by (sclone_job, reason) (count_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_conflict" | logfmt | event="sync_conflict" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Error and warning logs
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the `level=error` and `level=warn` lines of the selected jobs, most recent first. The *Event* variable filters the `event` field (regex).

**Normal value**: empty, or a few isolated warnings.

**When to worry / what to do**: type an event in *Event* (e.g. `deletion_refused`, `transfer_failed`, `sync_skipped`) then expand a line to read its fields. To follow a whole run, copy its `run` id and search `run=<id>` in Explore.

targets.expr: ${selector} |~ "level=(error|warn)" | logfmt | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | event=~"${event}"

panels.title: Run duration p50 / p95
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the median (p50) and 95th percentile (p95) run duration per hour (`sync_end`, field `duration_ms`).

**Normal value**: stable from day to day. The thresholds (orange 2 min, red 3 min) fit a cron every 3 minutes: **adjust them** to your cron interval.

**When to worry / what to do**: a p95 close to the cron interval causes skipped runs (*Skipped runs by reason*). Compare with *Listing duration p95* (slow storage) and *Files transferred* (large volume).

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, ${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__interval]) by (sclone_job)

quantile_over_time(0.95, ${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__interval]) by (sclone_job)

panels.title: Listing duration p95
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the 95th percentile listing time per hour, by job, side and bucket (`listing_done`, field `duration_ms`).

**Normal value**: proportional to the number of objects. Indicative thresholds (orange 30 s, red 60 s): **adjust them** to your bucket sizes.

**When to worry / what to do**: a rise without more objects (*Objects per bucket*): slow storage, see also the `listing_retry` in *Connection and listing failures*.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, ${selector} |= "event=listing_done" | logfmt | event="listing_done" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__interval]) by (sclone_job, side, bucket)

panels.title: Upload throughput
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the bytes uploaded per second, averaged over each 15 min slot (`sync_end`, field `uploaded_bytes`). Not the instant speed during a run.

**Normal value**: depends on the activity: peaks when many files are added, close to 0 otherwise.

**When to worry / what to do**: no throughput while files should be copied: see *Failed files* and *Runs*.

targets.expr: sum by (sclone_job) (rate(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | unwrap uploaded_bytes | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Uploaded volume
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the bytes uploaded per 15 min slot (sum of the `uploaded_bytes` field of `sync_end`).

**Normal value**: depends on the activity.

**When to worry / what to do**: an unusual volume (peak or none): compare with *Files transferred* and *Bytes per bucket*.

targets.expr: sum by (sclone_job) (sum_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | unwrap uploaded_bytes | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Files transferred
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the files uploaded (`uploaded`), deleted (`deleted`) and failed (`failed`) per 15 min slot (fields of `sync_end`).

**Normal value**: uploads and deletions following the activity; no red bar.

**When to worry / what to do**: failures (red): see *Failures by HTTP status*. Unexpected mass deletions: check the source and `maxDeletion`.

targets.expr: sum by (sclone_job) (sum_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | unwrap uploaded | __error__="" [$__interval]))

sum by (sclone_job) (sum_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | unwrap deleted | __error__="" [$__interval]))

sum by (sclone_job) (sum_over_time(${selector} |= "event=sync_end" | logfmt | event="sync_end" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | unwrap failed | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Objects per bucket
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the number of listed objects by job, side (`source`, `target`) and bucket (`listing_done`, field `objects`).

**Normal value**: in unidirectional mode the target follows the source; the curves move slowly.

**When to worry / what to do**: a lasting gap between source and target: see *Failed files* and *Refused deletions*. A sudden drop on one side: check the bucket before the next run (`maxDeletion` protects the target).

targets.expr: max by (sclone_job, side, bucket) (max_over_time(${selector} |= "event=listing_done" | logfmt | event="listing_done" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | unwrap objects | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Bytes per bucket
panels.description:
**What it measures**: the sum of the listed object sizes by job, side and bucket (`listing_done`, field `bytes`).

**Normal value**: the target follows the source; steady growth.

**When to worry / what to do**: a lasting gap between source and target: see *Failed files* and *Files too large*.

targets.expr: max by (sclone_job, side, bucket) (max_over_time(${selector} |= "event=listing_done" | logfmt | event="listing_done" | label_format sclone_job="{{ or .job_extracted .job }}" | sclone_job=~"${job}" | unwrap bytes | __error__="" [$__interval]))
